query: How do I make creamy blue cheese dip?

goal.title: Make blue cheese dip and serve with crackers
goal.description: Measure sour cream, mayonnaise and blue cheese into a bowl, stir in a spoonful of white liquid and visible seasonings, then transfer the dip to a blue serving bowl and arrange crackers around it.
goal.final_state: The blue bowl of thick white cheese dip sits on a white plate surrounded by crackers. The bowl was briefly placed in and immediately retrieved from the refrigerator.

procedure.description: Open the wall cupboard, take a white mixing bowl and carry it to the counter. Reposition a cream-colored mug, lift and open the sour cream tub, set its lid beside the sink and pick up a teaspoon. Repeatedly spoon sour cream into the mug. Put the tub down, lift the mug and scrape its contents into the white bowl.

Set the mug and teaspoon down and open the blue-lidded mayonnaise jar. Turn and shake the jar over the mug, but no substantial flow is visible. Open the drawer, retrieve a tablespoon and repeatedly scoop mayonnaise into the mug instead. Set the jar aside, lift the mug and use the smaller spoon to scrape its contents into the mixing bowl. Set the mug down and release the spoon.

Lift and open a nearly empty blue cheese tub. Invert it over the cream mug and tap its base to release the remaining crumbles. Set it aside and open a second, fuller tub, removing its lid and peeling off the inner plastic seal. Pour more crumbles into the mug, set the tub down, then tip the mug over the white bowl. Use the teaspoon to scrape the remaining cheese and creamy residue into the bowl, then place the mug on the back counter.

Retrieve the tablespoon, transfer it to the right hand and pick up the teal cup with the left. Scoop a spoonful of opaque white liquid from the cup and add it to the mixing bowl; its exact identity is not established by visible packaging. Leave the tablespoon in the cup and set it down. Pick up the teaspoon and repeatedly stir the cheese and creamy ingredients. Open the pepper grinder, grind pepper over the mixture and set it down. Open a separate seasoning jar, shake orange-tan powder over the dip, close and set down that jar, then stir the seasonings through.

Bring a small blue serving bowl beside the mixture. Lift the white mixing bowl, tilt it over the blue bowl and repeatedly scrape the dip into it with the teaspoon. Put the white bowl and spoon in the sink, pick up the blue bowl and carry it to the refrigerator. Open the refrigerator, place the bowl on a shelf and close the door.

Pause briefly, reopen the refrigerator and retrieve the blue bowl almost immediately. Carry it back to the counter and set it on a white plate. Lift and open the rectangular cracker container, place its lid aside and repeatedly take crackers with both hands, arranging them on the plate around the blue bowl. Withdraw the hands, leaving the dip and crackers together. This is a brief refrigerator placement rather than evidence of a long chilling period.
